summary: First full test run of ReLoop (FastAPI+Mongo+React). Backend: 28 pytest tests PASS (auth w/ role mismatch, pickups CRUD + rate math + Tons*1000 + customer-cancel-only-pending + delivery can't update completed + role 403s, zone CRUD, settings rate change reflected in new pickups, admin users CRUD + deactivate blocks login, compliance role gating, profile update + password change-and-restore). Frontend: login works for all 5 roles, role dropdown mismatch shows login-error, every role sidebar menu item (nav-*) matches ROLE_MENUS and loads without visible errors. Sell Scrap: 10 kg Plastics -> ₹180, Tons toggle multiplies by 1000 (10 Tons -> ₹1,80,000); submit creates pickup and lands on My Pickups as Pending. Customer cancel of Pending pickup works. Delivery partner Accept Order + status-select-{id} status change works. Partner Area Management add-zone-btn present + export CSV present. Mobile 390px shows mobile-menu-btn and overview renders.

issues: Right half has a very large empty whitespace block below the form on desktop (1920x1080) - the form could be centered better vertically; cosmetic only

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /scrap/pickups/all does not expose `assigned=me` filter for admin's own view; minor
server.py: no DELETE endpoint for pickups - TEST_ pickups created during tests remain in DB (seed_data pollution risk over many iterations)
server.py: @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan context manager
server.py: login brute-force lockout keyed on ip:email but ip from request.client.host - behind ingress all requests share host; low impact but note it
No rate limit on /api/login success path - acceptable for MVP
DashboardPage/views look fine; data-testid coverage is excellent
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md - all 5 role accounts work. Partner password was temporarily changed to 'newpw_TEST_123' and restored to 'partner@123' at end of test.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ pickups for public (test29) and corporate (test30), one TEST_ zone (deleted by test), one TEST_ admin-created user (deleted). Pickup RL-C3C5A9 cancelled; RL-F49687 accepted and set to In Progress by delivery_partner. Settings Plastics rate was temporarily set to 25 then restored to 18.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and all role flows pass. Reusable regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_reloop_api.py - run with `pytest backend/tests/test_reloop_api.py -v`. Note: tests mutate real seed data (create pickups) but settings and partner password are restored. TEST_ prefixed pickups accumulate because there is no delete-pickup endpoint. Lockout window is 15 min on ip:email after 5 fails - avoid brute-forcing real accounts.
